trigger.description: Create a chat service that WSO2 Agent Manager calls to chat with the agent.

metadata.label: Service Path
metadata.description: The base path the chat service is served on. Agent Manager calls /chat at the root of the agent's endpoint, so keep / unless the agent's endpoint in Agent Manager includes a path.

metadata.label: Agent Manager Listener
metadata.description: Serves Agent Manager chat services over HTTP.

section.label: Agent Manager Listener
section.description: Attach the agent to a new or existing Agent Manager listener.

createNew.label: Create New Listener
createNew.description: Define a new Agent Manager listener in the project.

useExisting.label: Use Existing Listener
useExisting.description: Attach to an Agent Manager listener already declared in the project.

existingListener.label: Listener
existingListener.description: Select an existing Agent Manager listener to attach the agent to.

metadata.label: Listener Name
metadata.description: Provide a name for the listener being created

metadata.label: Port
metadata.description: The port to listen on, or an existing http:Listener to share. Use the port the agent is configured with in Agent Manager.

metadata.label: WSO2 Agent Manager Chat Service
metadata.description: Handles chat messages from WSO2 Agent Manager through a fixed POST /chat resource.

metadata.label: Chat
metadata.description: Handles POST /chat: runs the agent on the user's message and returns its reply.

metadata.label: Chat Request
metadata.description: The session ID, the user's message and optional context.
